messages:
Tess: Starting deploy prep for gateway-api 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0. QA saw flaky session-affinity behavior. Proposing we pin a canary artifact and gate the session-affinity-v3 flag ramp behind it. ok?
Liam: Sounds good. What ramp numbers are we thinking?
QA: Reproduced intermittent 502 when affinity flips for long-lived connections under load. Not huge rate but consistent in stress tests.
Liam: Plan: pin canary to v1.9.0-canary-20260321, run 0.5% for 12m, 3% for 18m, 20% for 25m. Keep feature flag disabled initially; enable cookie-sticky variant at 3% mark.
deploybot: preflight completed with warnings: [session-affinity-change-detected]. To pin canary: `rbctl artifacts pin --service gateway-api --version v1.9.0-canary-20260321`. Softhold: `@deploybot softhold on`. Abort: `@deploybot abort`.
sre-oncall: Add explicit rollback triggers: >0.8% 5xx OR p95 +150ms over baseline sustained for 2x5m -> softhold. If queue depth on ingress hosts >80% capacity -> immediate abort.
Product: We'll pause the related experiment E-conn-stability during the ramp to avoid skewing data. Marking the release notes to state that affinity change is behind FF.
Tess: Good. Concrete toggle flow for session-affinity-v3: start OFF. After canary 0.5% passes 12m, leave flag OFF. At 3% we enable cookie-sticky variant to 3% cohort only. Monitor. At 20% enable full flag. Each step requires green checks from SRE and QA.
Liam: Helper commands:```
rbctl artifacts pin --service gateway-api --version v1.9.0-canary-20260321 --reason "canary pin for affinity change"
rbctl artifacts unpin --service gateway-api --version v1.9.0-canary-20260321
rbctl feature toggle --name session-affinity-v3 --set pct:3 --cohort canary
```
QA: I'll run the lightweight smoke suite against the canary cohort and post summaries to this thread. Will run affinity stress for 10m at each step.
deploybot: scheduled job deploy/gateway-api/2026-03-21-02:00 pinned -> v1.9.0-canary-20260321. Softhold available.
sre-oncall: Watchlist for canary: 1) 5xx rate, 2) p95 latency, 3) connection churn, 4) ingress queue depth. If any threshold crosses, announce and `@deploybot softhold on`.
Tess: If softhold invoked, proposed runbook: 1) `@deploybot softhold on` stops further ramps. 2) `rbctl route set --cohort canary --pct 0.0` to begin draining new sessions into stable. 3) Run quick rollback drill: `@deploybot abort` to revert to v1.8.0 if unstable after 10m. 4) Notify Product + QA, open incident if user-impacting. Copy this into release notes.
Liam: I'll add the release note snippet and ensure the deploy window has a 15m post-ramp cooldown.
Tess: OK launching pin at 02:00. Watchers: @sre-oncall, @QA, @Liam. Post issues here fast. :eyes:
